en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a broad river with several moored and passing boats. In the foreground are tree‑covered banks; a long pier or jetty extends into the water with barges alongside. In the distance a large arched bridge crosses the river and low buildings and fields lie beyond. Printed text at the top left reads in Dutch: "Nijmegen. Panorama vanuit Lent gezien."
